projects.title: Product Listing App (REST API)
projects.summary: Fetches products from a public REST API with Retrofit, shows them in a RecyclerView with images, and handles loading, error and retry states.
features: ProductActivity with a RecyclerView and a custom item layout
Glide for image loading and caching
Progress bar while loading, error panel with a working Retry button when the call fails (for example no internet)
INTERNET permission declared in the manifest
run: Open the folder projects/job-1-product-listing-rest in Android Studio.
Let Gradle sync finish (Android Studio creates local.properties for you).
Run on an emulator or a real device with internet access.
Turn on airplane mode and relaunch to see the error state, then turn it off and tap Retry.

projects.title: User Profile Registration (SQLite / Room)
projects.summary: Local profile manager with a welcome screen, profile list, add, view, update and delete, built with MVVM, LiveData and Room (SQLite).
features: WelcomeActivity as launcher, then ProfileListActivity with all saved profiles
AddProfileActivity: name, email, date of birth, district, mobile
SingleProfileActivity to view a profile, with Edit and Delete buttons
Room database (SQLite) with Entity, DAO (insert, update, delete, queries), Repository and ViewModel
Data stays on the device, no internet needed
run: Open the folder projects/job-2-user-profile-sqlite in Android Studio.
Sync Gradle, then run on an emulator or device.
Add a profile, open it from the list, then try update and delete.

projects.title: Location Sharing App (Firebase + Google Maps)
projects.summary: Users sign up, share their live location, see everyone in a list and on Google Maps, and edit their own profile. Firebase Auth and Cloud Firestore with MVVM.
features: AuthActivity: email and password sign up and login with Firebase Authentication
Location permission flow and live updates with FusedLocationProviderClient, saved to Cloud Firestore
FriendListActivity: all users in a RecyclerView, with an options menu (My Profile, Show users on Map, Logout)
GoogleMapActivity: a marker for every user (name as title, phone in the info window), your own marker in green
MyProfileActivity to update your display name and phone number
run: Open the folder projects/job-3-location-sharing-firebase in Android Studio.
Create your own Firebase project and add an Android app with package name com.example.locationsharingapp.
Enable Email/Password sign-in and Cloud Firestore, then download google-services.json into the app/ folder.
Create a Google Maps API key (Maps SDK for Android) and add MAPS_API_KEY=your_key to local.properties.
Sync Gradle and run on a device or an emulator with Google Play services.
projects.setup: This project needs two private values that are intentionally NOT in the repository: your own google-services.json (use app/google-services.json.example as a guide) and a MAPS_API_KEY line in local.properties. Both files are git-ignored.
